title: computeInitialAccelerations
author: JG
description: add WARNING for inconsistent initial velocities - which usually cause heavy oscillations in constraint forces
releaseNotes: the implicit solver checks the initial positions and velocities against the constraints and warns, naming the item, if the residual exceeds generalizedAlpha.initialConstraintsTolerance (generalizedAlpha.checkInitialConstraints switches it off; a constraint without velocity level is reported and skipped); generalizedAlpha.projectInitialVelocities projects the initial velocities onto the constraints; the residuals are in the solver output, exu.special.solver.initialConstraintsViolations counts such runs and the test suite lists them per model; test model initialConstraintsCheckTest.py (revision2026c step RG11.8.9)
